data.one_liner: Provides real‑time keyboard height and visibility streams for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: The plugin emits per‑frame keyboard inset values and a state stream indicating visibility and animation status. It also offers a SafeArea widget that keeps bottom padding stable during keyboard animations.
use_when: You need precise keyboard height for custom UI adjustments
You want to react to keyboard visibility without using MediaQuery
You need a stable bottom safe‑area while the keyboard animates
avoid_when: You only need occasional keyboard height (MediaQuery is sufficient)
You target platforms without keyboard support (e.g., desktop)
weaknesses: Desktop returns zero insets (no keyboard support)
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, ensure iOS Podfile sets platform to '13.0' or higher; no additional permissions required.
